title: Acceptance evidence reads validate full record ids and check fingerprints with the 8–64-hex citation-locator check instead of the record-id and SHA-256 validators
outcome: Acceptance evidence reads validate full record ids and check fingerprints with the 8–64-hex citation-locator check instead of the record-id and SHA-256 validators
acceptance: Full Engram record ids read for acceptance evidence (obligation definition, triggering observation, resolution record, bound verification and sighting, verification record and producer record) are validated with is_engram_record_id, check fingerprints with the existing SHA-256 validator, and is_citable_acceptance_locator remains only for user/evaluator citation locators

Deterministic tests show a too-short or wrong-kind value in each of those fields is refused while valid 32-hex and legacy 64-hex record ids and 64-hex fingerprints are accepted, and existing citation-locator behaviour is unchanged
Exact-input focused tests, the maintained full gate and an independent review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding

completion.summary: Full record-ID and SHA-256 validation landed in combo40; generated field-refusal tests, independent pair and six-stage exact-tree gate passed.
